# Chirag Kushwaha - Complete Engineering Dossier & Portfolio Architecture

## Professional Summary
Chirag Kushwaha is a Full Stack Engineer specialized in crafting resilient web architectures, native-fidelity browser interfaces, and scalable distributed applications.

- **Primary URL**: https://chirag.rocks
- **Canonical API**: https://chirag.rocks/api
- **Source Code / Repositories**: https://github.com/chirag-kushwaha
- **Professional Network**: https://linkedin.com/in/chirag-kushwaha

## Core Competencies
- **Frontend Systems**: React 19, Next.js (App Router, Server Components, Turbopack, i18n), TypeScript 5.8, Tailwind CSS v4, Web Workers, Canvas, Service Workers, Web Audio, Web Speech.
- **Client Storage & Offline**: Origin Private File System (OPFS), IndexedDB, Cache Storage, Service Worker caching strategies (Cache-First, Network-First, Stale-While-Revalidate).
- **Web Platform Capabilities**:
  - Presentation API / Remote Playback / WebRTC getDisplayMedia (AirPlay & Cast Display).
  - Web Bluetooth API (Bluetooth accessory discovery and pairing).
  - Web Battery API (Hardware level monitoring and power event triggers).
  - Fullscreen API & Window Controls Overlay.
  - Web Speech API (VoiceOver synthesis and screen voice feedback).
  - Storage Estimate API (Quota tracking and disk partition telemetry).
- **Accessibility & Compliance**:
  - WCAG AAA standard compliance:
    - 7:1 normal text contrast ratio, 4.5:1 large text contrast ratio.
    - Keyboard traps prevention and focus visible states.
    - Skip links (`#main-desktop-area`, `#main-menubar`, `#main-dock`).
    - Semantic landmarks (`banner`, `main`, `navigation`, `region`, `dialog`).
    - `@media (prefers-reduced-motion)` motion smoothing and graceful fallbacks.
  - PWA Builder:
    - Web App Manifest v3.
    - Offline fallback with custom service worker.
    - Dual form-factor screenshots (wide & narrow).
    - Window-controls-overlay and standalone display modes.

## Apps Available in macOS Big Sur Clone
1. **Finder**: File manager exploring Desktop, Documents, Applications, Pictures, and Trash using OPFS sandboxed storage.
2. **Terminal**: Interactive shell with built-in commands (ls, cat, pwd, clear, help, open, neofetch, theme).
3. **PDF Viewer (Resume)**: High fidelity PDF document previewer with zoom, page navigation, and download.
4. **Calculator**: macOS Big Sur arithmetic engine supporting chained computations and floating-point logic.
5. **System Settings**: Modular macOS Ventura/Big Sur settings suite including Wallpaper, Displays, Battery, Bluetooth, Accessibility, Storage, General Hardware, and Appearance.
6. **Notification Center**: Slide-out widget sidebar featuring real-time financial market tickers, live meteorological forecasting, reminders, notes, and calendar.
7. **Spotlight Search**: Universal application, file, and external app search launched via Cmd+Space or Menu Bar icon.
8. **Launchpad**: Full-screen application dashboard with instant search filter.

## External Featured Engineering Projects

- **AlgoViz** (https://algorithms.sacred-texts.xyz): Visual dynamic programming, graph algorithms, and sorting simulator.
- **SpeakSpanish** (https://sp4nish.vercel.app): Interactive audio and conversational language instruction platform.
- **Toonflix** (https://t00nflix.vercel.app): Animated video streaming interface.
